Yes, your rubber plant is covered by our Plant Care Guarantee, and it's separate from the cracked pot report.

**How the guarantee works:**
- It lasts **30 days from delivery** (90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member).
- If the plant dies or declines significantly despite reasonable care, we send **one free replacement** of the same plant (store credit if it's out of stock).
- "Significant decline" means losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse.
- Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress and isn't covered on its own.

**To make a claim:**
- Go to **"My Orders"** within the guarantee window.
- Add **at least two photos**: the whole plant and a close-up.
- A Plant Care Specialist reviews it within **2 business days**, and you don't need to send the plant back.

**What isn't covered:**
- Repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days.
- Pests introduced after delivery, pet damage, or deliberate neglect.
- Claims made after the window.

Because of the cracked pot, you might be tempted to repot right away. Please hold off if you can, or use Leafy soil, since non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days would void the guarantee. Our care card suggests keeping new plants out of direct sun for the first week and not repotting for 2-3 weeks. Water only when the top inch of soil is dry, as overwatering causes most early problems.

If you want advice, Plant Care Specialists are available by chat 9am-5pm Mon-Fri, or by email, and it's free.

Is there anything else I can help with? I hope your rubber plant settles in beautifully! 🌿
